patch_description: Apply the recommendation: a percentile-blended multi-scale Savitzky-Golay kernel bank that runs only inside the trend-reversal-gated (boost) regions, combined with a volatility-percentile weighting. In high-volatility regions (upper percentiles of local volatility), the filter uses wider SG half-widths for aggressive noise reduction, while in low-volatility regions it uses narrower kernels to preserve responsiveness. This targets the smoothness_score (0.20, the weakest metric) without sacrificing lag, since the RTS smoother already handles baseline smoothness and the SG pass is localized to weak-gradient flagged neighborhoods (extending _local_hysteresis with a volatility-weighted 3-scale kernel blend instead of the single fixed 5-tap kernel).
